subject: CrossRealm co-hosted demo series + shared booth at Inference Summit

To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: Allie Chen <allie@eventrix.co>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Proposal: joint demo series + shared booth at Inference Summit

Hi Michael —

Hope you’re well. CrossRealm is launching a small demo series that culminates at Inference Summit (mid-July). We’d love to co-host a 45-minute technical demo + fireside with Redwood, and explore a shared booth presence at the show. High-level ask: $15k MDF to cover booth space, design, and a joint demand gen push (email + paid social).

Audience: ML infra and platform engineers (customer list is aligned with Redwood’s audience). Proposed speakers: Liam O'Connor (CrossRealm), one engineer from Redwood for a demo on multi-model routing.

Attached a short MDF proposal and a rough audience/KPI ask. Can you let me know who at Redwood owns partner co-marketing and whether this is feasible? If so, we can send a MAP and speaker bios.

Attachments: CrossRealm_MDF_Proposal.pdf (stub)

—Liam
Partnerships Lead, CrossRealm AI
liam@crossrealm.ai

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the note and for thinking of Redwood. Ben (field marketing) and Naomi (partner ops) are looped in — they’ll own budget and logistics. A couple quick asks from our side before we commit:

- Can you fill out a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on deliverables, dates, and lead routing?
- Target KPIs: 400 webinar signups, 120 qualified leads at the booth, 40 MQLs. If you have different numbers, flag them.
- Who will manage registration pages and the paid social creative?

I attached our MAP template to speed things up. Availability: I can do a 30-minute sync on Friday (US-PST) if that works.

Hi all —

Eventrix here (logistics vendor) — quick overview of booth options and AV for Inference Summit:

- Shell size: 10x10 or 10x20 available; 10x10 includes draped walls, single monitor stand; 10x20 includes larger island footprint.
- AV: basic package (single 55" monitor + mic) = $1,200, premium (dual monitors + mic + demo laptop + on-site tech) = $2,800.
- Lead capture: badge scanner rental ($250/day) or custom iPad lead form ($150/day + one-time setup $300).

Typical timeline: final floorplan and AV picks due 6 weeks before show. We can provide design mockups.

Date: Thu, 06 May 2026 23:42:00 +0000
Subject: internal: CrossRealm MDF math & asks

Internal note — not for external circulation.

Read Liam's MDF ask: $15k total. Recommended Redwood posture: propose a 60/40 split in Redwood's favor (we cover 60% of MDF if partner brings co-fund and helps with demand gen). That lands at Redwood $9k / CrossRealm $6k. Given CrossRealm is a smaller partner, propose we offer a $10k credit (to push commitment) and Redwood covers travel for their speaker to lock a session slot.

Operational asks for Naomi: set lead handoff to Sales Ops (SFDC campaign to be created), confirm available demo engineer for July 13 (or alternate week), and confirm whether marketing will run the registration landing page (we prefer to host).

I'll draft the MAP language; need sign-off from Michael on the $10k credit vs $9k numeric split.

—Ben
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Liam / Allie —

Thanks — we reviewed internally and are excited to move forward. Proposed terms:

- MDF: Redwood will commit $7,200 (60%) and CrossRealm $4,800 (40%). To simplify contracting, Redwood can offer a $10k marketing credit (applied to MDF/ads) and cover the speaker travel.
- Dates: target webinar on Tue, 13 Jul 2026 (45 min demo + 15 min Q&A). Booth presence across the conference days — final floorplan by 30 May.
- Responsibilities: Redwood will run the registration landing page and own lead sync. CrossRealm will provide speaker slide deck and two speaker bios by 12 May. Eventrix to confirm booth dimensions and AV pick by 20 May.

I've attached an updated MAP with the MDF split and milestones. Once we confirm, Naomi will send a short partner agreement and PO instructions.

Attachment: MAP_CrossRealm_Redwood_v1.xlsx (updated stub)
